amount.description: What it moves from 2400 Deferred revenue to the line's account, in the base currency: its ALLOC-EVEN part of the line's net.

date.description: The day it posts: the first of its month, or the invoice's date when that is later.

line.description: The invoice's line it releases, from 1.

of.description: How many months the line is spread over.

part.description: Which month of the spread it is, from 1.

status.description: posted; waiting: due by the organisation's today but not in the ledger yet (the hourly job posts it, or waits for its period to open); projected: in the future, or of a draft, and not in the ledger (ENG-05); reversed by a void or an edit of the invoice.
